Frequently Asked Questions

What is the revenue of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month revenue of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. is ₹ 25,277.40 Cr, reflecting a 1-year growth of 14.83% and a 3-year CAGR of 29.32%. Annual and quarterly revenue trends are available in the Income Statement section.
What is the net profit of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month net profit (PAT) of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. is ₹ 465.76 Cr, with a 3-year earnings CAGR of 51.46%. Detailed profit history across annual and quarterly periods is in the Income Statement section.
What is the EBITDA of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month EBITDA of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. is approximately ₹ 650.80 Cr (based on an operating margin of 2.57%). EBITDA reflects core operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation.
What is the EPS of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month Earnings Per Share (EPS) of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. is 15.77. EPS trends across annual and quarterly periods are visible in the Income Statement section.
What is the debt level of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd.?
The debt-to-equity ratio of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. stands at 0.36. The interest coverage ratio is 3.80x, reflecting the company's ability to service debt from operating earnings. The full breakdown of total borrowings is in the Balance Sheet section.
What is the book value per share of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd.?
The estimated book value per share of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. is 57.49 (derived from a P/B ratio of 3.77 and market price of ₹ 216.52), reflecting the net asset value attributable to each share. See the Balance Sheet section for a full breakdown.
What is the cash flow from operations of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month operating cash flow of Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. is ₹ 202.43 Cr. Annual and quarterly cash flow data is available in the Cash Flow section of the Statements tab.
Does Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. report consolidated or standalone financials?
Gokul Agro Resources Ltd. reports consolidated financials. You can toggle between consolidated and standalone views using the switch at the top of each statement section.
